title: ISic002139. Fragment of a Greek funerary inscription
body:
Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Prag 2014-09-09, cassette 2, magazzino B, Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi
1χρη[στ. 1-2. καὶ]
2ἄμ͡εμ̣[πτ. 1-2.]
3ἐβίω[σε ---]
4·Μ̣[---]

Text encoding: Jonathan Prag; edition source: autopsy Prag 2014-09-09, cassette 2, magazzino B, Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi
1ΧΡΗ[... 1-2....]
2ΑΜ͡Ε.[... 1-2.]
3ΕΒΙΩ[..---]
4·.[---]

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text based on autopsy;
  • 1: The ending of χρηστὸς is uncertain
  • 2: The ending of ἄμεμπτος is uncertain (and the alternative spelling ἄμενπτος also possible)
  • 4: N is just possible, but there is no trace of the vertical to the right.

English translation

Jonathan Prag

[----] worthy and blameless, lived [---]

commentary

The name of the deceased is missing from above line 1. The formula χρηστὸς καὶ αμ̓́εμπτος is distinctive to the Syracusan region. The verb ἐβίωσε(ν) instead of ἔζησε(ν) is relatively rare, although attested in use in Sicily. The Μ preceded by an interpunct in the final line is likely to be a numeral from the age of the deceased, with ἔτη to be restored at the end of line 3.

bibliography

V-cut letters with wedge serifs; use of ligature; quadrate epsilon, uncial omega.

Line 2 22 Line 3 15-16 Interlineation line 1 to 2
